mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% (FEDFUNDS < 2.0) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as lower rates reduce discount rates for equity valuations and stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% (UNRATE > 4.0), it signals economic weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) and a rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) signals stagflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as investors price in economic stagnation and rising costs.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 105 and CPIAUCSL > 250, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300 thousand units, it signals a late-cycle expansion where economic overheating concerns lead to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as investors anticipate monetary tightening.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1300, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105 (INDPRO < 105) signals a manufacturing slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors price in reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 105, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales above 500,000 (RSAFS > 500000) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as strong consumer spending supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 500000, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 3.9) and decline in payrolls (PAYEMS < 148500) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 3.9 and PAYEMS < 148500, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL > 250.5) signals persistent inflation that leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the Fed delays rate cuts.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 250.5, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
